vpn_proxy.title: 🛡️ VPN / Proxy Detected
vpn_proxy.description: The loader detected a VPN or proxy connection which is not allowed.
fixes: **Disable your VPN/Proxy** - Turn off any VPN, proxy, or network tunneling software
**Check browser extensions** - Disable VPN/proxy browser extensions
**Restart your router** - Some routers have built-in VPN features that need to be disabled
**Clear DNS cache** - Run `ipconfig /flushdns` in Command Prompt
**Check for system-wide VPN** - Look in Windows Settings → Network & Internet → VPN

driver_failed.title: 🔧 Driver Initialization Failed
driver_failed.description: The loader's driver failed to initialize properly.
fixes: **Restart your PC** - A simple restart often fixes driver issues
**Disable antivirus temporarily** - Windows Defender or third-party antivirus may be blocking the driver
**Run as Administrator** - Right-click the loader and select 'Run as administrator'
**Check Secure Boot** - Disable Secure Boot in BIOS if enabled
**Reinstall the loader** - Delete and re-download the loader
**Check Windows version** - Ensure you're running a supported Windows version

invalid_key.title: 🔑 Invalid Product Key
invalid_key.description: The product key you entered is not valid or has expired.
fixes: **Double-check your key** - Make sure you copied it correctly without extra spaces
**Check key expiration** - Your key may have expired, check your purchase date
**Verify purchase email** - Look for the key in your original purchase confirmation
**Contact support** - If you believe this is an error, create a ticket with your invoice ID
**Check for typos** - Keys are case-sensitive and must match exactly

no_response.title: ⏳ No Response from Loader
no_response.description: The loader is not responding or appears frozen.
fixes: **Wait 30-60 seconds** - The loader may still be initializing
**Check Task Manager** - End any existing loader processes and restart
**Disable antivirus** - Your antivirus may be quarantining the loader
**Check firewall** - Allow the loader through Windows Firewall
**Run compatibility mode** - Right-click → Properties → Compatibility → Windows 8
**Redownload the loader** - Your file may be corrupted

hwid_mismatch.title: 💻 HWID Mismatch
hwid_mismatch.description: Your hardware ID doesn't match the one registered to your key.
fixes: **Use `/hwid` command** - Request a HWID reset (max 2 per 30 days)
**Check if you changed hardware** - Replacing major components changes your HWID
**Don't share your key** - Each key is tied to one unique PC
**Wait for reset cooldown** - If you've used both resets, you must wait 30 days
**Contact support** - If this is unexpected, create a ticket with your invoice ID

defender_issues.title: 🛡️ Windows Defender Issues
defender_issues.description: Windows Defender is blocking or quarantining the loader.
fixes: **Add exclusion** - Add the loader folder to Windows Defender exclusions
**Disable Real-Time Protection** - Temporarily turn off real-time protection
**Check quarantine** - Restore the loader from Defender's quarantine
**Run as Administrator** - Right-click and select 'Run as administrator'
**Disable Cloud Protection** - Turn off cloud-delivered protection in Defender settings

auto_close.title: ⚠️ Loader Closed Automatically
auto_close.description: The loader closes immediately after opening.
fixes: **Check antivirus logs** - Your antivirus may be terminating the process
**Disable all security software** - Turn off Windows Defender and any third-party antivirus
**Run as Administrator** - Right-click the loader and select 'Run as administrator'
**Check for conflicting software** - Close any cheat detection software or anti-cheat programs
**Reinstall Visual C++ Runtimes** - Use `.runtimes` command for download link
**Check Windows Event Viewer** - Look for crash logs to identify the issue
